pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.5: sādhūti paṭissuṇitvā neva vūpasameti na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.6: athakho sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.7: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā bhikkhuniyo
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.10: sādhūti paṭissuṇitvā neva vūpasamessati na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.13: sādhūti paṭissuṇitvā neva vūpasameti na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karotīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.16: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.18: sādhūti paṭissuṇitvā neva vūpasamessati na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.20: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.21.1: yā pana bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā ehayye imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamehīti vuccamānā sādhūti paṭissuṇitvā sā pacchā anantarāyikinī neva vūpasameyya na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ kareyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:2.1.8: cattāri adhikaraṇāni vivādādhikaraṇaṃ anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kiccādhikaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:2.1.17: neva vūpasamessāmi na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karissāmīti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:2.2.1: upasampannāya upasampannasaññā adhikaraṇaṃ neva vūpasameti na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karoti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:2.2.2: upasampannāya vematikā adhikaraṇaṃ neva vūpasameti na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karoti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:2.2.3: upasampannāya anupasampannasaññā adhikaraṇaṃ neva vūpasameti na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karoti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:2.2.4: anupasampannāya adhikaraṇaṃ neva vūpasameti na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karoti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
